JobResponse.description:
A background job (PMO-18): poll ``GET /api/jobs/{id}`` until ``status`` is final.

``processed`` counts successes and failures; ``failed_count`` is the failures so
far. ``counts`` holds the kind-specific final numbers (index: ``total``,
``indexed``, ``failed``; sync: ``new``, ``modified``, ``deleted``, ``unchanged``,
``fingerprints_refreshed``, ``failed``). ``errors`` lists per-file messages, capped.

post.description:
Without ``labels`` this takes every open suggestion of the selected photos; with them,
exactly those labels. Unknown photos are skipped.

post.description:
Start the one-time model download as a job (progress is in bytes).

The body must say ``{"accept": true}``: the UI sends it only after telling the user what is
fetched (size, source, licence). Only the model is downloaded; no photo data is sent.
post.summary: Download the AI model (needs explicit consent)

post.description:
Analyze every photo that has no embedding from the current model, as a job.

Incremental and safe to repeat. ``reanalyze`` redoes everything; ``limit`` caps one run.
Refused with 503 without the ``ai`` extra and 409 without the model or while another AI job
runs. Suggestions never change the user's labels until accepted.
post.summary: Analyze the library: embeddings and suggested tags

The usual search filters apply and decide who competes. Returns the ``k`` best matches,
best first. 409 if nothing (or that photo) has been analysed yet.

post.description:
Re-scan a folder and apply only what changed (NEW / MODIFIED / DELETED).

Returns a job at once (202); its final ``counts`` report ``new``, ``modified``,
``deleted`` and ``unchanged``. Deleted files are removed only with
``cleanup_deleted``; ``dry_run`` reports the counts and writes nothing. Only
records under ``folder_path`` are considered, so photos indexed from other
folders are never affected.
